items.question: Under what condition can a mind fixed on that object remain uncut even when the body is being severed?
premises: The body may be in the process of being cut.
A mind fixed on that object remains directed elsewhere.
Such fixation prevents the cutting from affecting that mind.
items.inference: A mind gone to that object is not cut in the same way as the body being severed.
uncertainties: Extent to which fixation blocks the effect remains unspecified
items.plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that object is not cut when the body is being cut, so too the effect does not reach it.
